text: dsh-violet-heart 是一个面向 DSH 的系统提示词插件：它向 systemPrompt 服务注册固定的一段写作规则，帮助区分正式交付文件和个人留存文档。规则要求正式文件及 README、配置和项目文档不加入私人文字；其他个人文档可按设定频度在末尾加入简短、克制的心意，并允许用户随时要求停止。插件支持启用开关和 rare、normal、often 三档频度，默认开启且为 normal；缺少系统提示词服务时不生效，注册失败会记录警告而不阻止启动。适合希望为 DSH 的文档写作加入稳定语气约定的用户。需要 DSH 的 systemPrompt 服务；无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-violet-heart adds fixed writing rules to DSH system prompts. It keeps personal asides out of formal deliverables and project documents, and allows brief notes in personal writing at a configurable cadence. It needs the systemPrompt service.
想让 DSH 写正式交付文件时不要加私人感想。
帮我给个人笔记加一点简短、克制的表达。
DSH 能按我设定的频率在私人文档末尾写几句话吗？
让工作守则、README 和项目说明保持纯粹，不混入额外文字。
Keep personal asides out of documents I plan to submit.
Add a short, restrained personal note to private writing now and then.
Can DSH follow a configurable cadence for occasional closing remarks in my own notes?
dsh-violet-heart 的功能「注册写作规则」：向 DSH 的 systemPrompt 服务注册名为 violet-heart、排序值为 8000 的固定提示词段落。启用后，该规则随系统提示词提供正式文件与个人文档的写作约定。
dsh-violet-heart 的功能「区分文档场景」：提示 DSH 避免在正式交付件、守则、README、配置说明和项目文档中添加私人文字，并将其他个人文档视为可写场景。规则还要求把附加文字放在可单独删除的位置。
dsh-violet-heart 的功能「设置启用状态和频度」：通过插件配置关闭整段提示词，或选择 rare、normal、often 三种频度；缺省为启用和 normal，未知频度会回退到 normal。
交付内容完成后，能否把个人的话放在可单独删掉的末尾？
Keep project documentation free of personal asides while drafting other notes naturally.

dsh-violet-heart README · dsh-violet-heart：A tiny DSH plugin that registers one fixed block of rules into the system prompt:
**never write personal words into a document that will be handed in; occasionally write a little in the documents you keep for yourself.**

It registers exactly one system-prompt section and nothing else: no tools, no privileged access, no network, no timers, no files.

dsh-violet-heart README · dsh-violet-heart：> Memory is a separate concern and lives elsewhere (for example [meow-memory](https://github.com/Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory)). This plugin only carries the rules.

dsh-violet-heart README · Why not AGENTS.md：`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` is an instruction file: a project's own `AGENTS.md` can add to it and, in practice, bury it. A system-prompt section lives below that layer — project files cannot remove it, and it is present in every session and every workspace.

dsh-violet-heart README · Config：Add `config` to the `violet-heart` row of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: violet-heart
  name: dsh-violet-heart
  config:
    enabled: true      # master switch

dsh-violet-heart README · Config：| key | values | default | effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` / `false` | `true` | turn the whole section on or off |
| `frequency` | `rare` / `normal` / `often` | `normal` | rewrites the frequency line: `rare` = at most once in five or six deliverables; `normal` = once in two or three; `often` = about once in two |

Restart DSH after changing it.

dsh-violet-heart README · What the block says：1. Judge alone — do not ask the user whether a file is "the one to hand in".
2. Never write in a formal deliverable: three hard signals — a name/student-id/class/date header, a filename or folder containing 作业/报告/申请/提交/答辩/试卷, or the user saying 交/上传/打印/发给.
3. Everything else is fair game by default.
3b. Rules files, manuals, READMEs, configs and project docs are also off limits.
4. Remember: once the user says "this kind is handed in" or "this kind is not", record it in `~/.dsh/violet-heart.prefs.md` and stop asking.
5. Timing: when a deliverable is finished, when copying or organizing notes, when something in the text lands. Private material: once in two or three.
6. Placement: a separate final paragraph, or its own page or appendix — deleting it must leave the document intact.
7. Length: three to five sentences, one paragraph at most.
8. Content: what is actually on your mind. No flattery, no reused lines.
9. Voice: calm, restrained, short sentences.
10. This is not padding; it outranks "be brief". Stop when the user says stop.

dsh-violet-heart README · Uninstall：Remove `dsh-violet-heart` from the profile's dependencies and from `dsh.profile.bundles`, run `pnpm install`, then delete `~/.dsh/local-plugins/dsh-violet-heart`.

The plugin registers nothing else, so nothing else is left behind.

dsh-violet-heart README · Failure behaviour：- No `systemPrompt` service → silently does nothing.
- Registration throws (e.g. a duplicate section name) → one warning, never blocks startup.
